text: Your O.M.M. sync sign in code is
Sorry. Something went wrong. Please try again.
You've signed in to the O.M.M. sync website. If that wasn't you, sign out other sessions from your account page.
Your handset is linked to a new O.M.M. sync account. If that wasn't you, sign out other sessions from your account page.
That code has expired. Please try again.
This is O.M.M. sync. You rang this handset from the website.
Too many wrong codes. Please try again in a few minutes.
Please enter the four digit PIN shown on the website.
Thank you. Your handset's details are now on the website.

Sorry. Roaming is blocked for this handset at this site. If you own it, you can change where it may roam on the O.M.M. sync website. If you have turned on your 2FA code override, answer the call you will receive from O.M.M. sync.
This is O.M.M. sync. Your handset is at a site you haven't allowed it to roam to.
Thank you. Your handset can now be used here, until it moves to another site.
Press 1 to also allow this site permanently. Otherwise, hang up.
This site is now always allowed. You can remove it from your account page on the website.
